# CEENTA (Charlotte Eye Ear Nose & Throat Associates)

> CEENTA is the Carolinas' largest multi-specialty eye, ear, nose, and throat practice offering comprehensive care for pediatric and adult patients with appointment scheduling, patient portals, and surgical services.

Founded in 1923, CEENTA operates multiple locations across North Carolina and South Carolina, including specialized surgery centers in SouthPark and Museum areas. The practice is recognized for medical innovation, top-ranked physicians, and community engagement through CEENTAcares.

## Patient Services & Scheduling

- [Scheduling Eye Appointment & ENT Appointment](https://www.ceenta.com/schedule-an-appointment): Schedule eye and ENT appointments at CEENTA with services and physicians
- [Charlotte Eye Ear Nose & Throat Patient Portal](https://www.ceenta.com/patient-portal): Login to myCEENTAchart patient portal for records, billing, and care
- [Medical Records Request at CEENTA](https://www.ceenta.com/medical-records): Request and access CEENTA medical records via HealthMark Group
- [Patient Education & Resources](https://www.ceenta.com/patient-education--resources): Patient education, forms, and resources for conditions and treatments
